apps.name: Ethical Games Installer
apps.game: Installs and updates the test builds

apps.name: Ethical Solitaire
apps.notes: Motion: cards glide between piles (on by default, Menu › Theme › Animate moves); Undo plays moves backwards. Rewind replaces Hint when a deal was last winnable more than 3 moves ago. Classic theme (red and black cards) replaces Programmer Art; Look is now Theme.

apps.name: Ethical FreeCell
apps.notes: First launch now always starts on a winnable deal (Pyramid and Golf could start on an unwinnable one). Hint now tells you when a position can no longer be won and how many moves to undo. Menu › About links to ethicalgames.app.

apps.notes: First playtest. Four levels; every puzzle has exactly one answer reachable by logic. Step-by-step hints (Look, Why, Answer), notes, number lock, Menu › Assists for mistake marking, blocking and highlights.
